# Vasdev — Vasyl Bakhmut, Web Developer & AI Automation Specialist, Melbourne

> Vasdev is the business of Vasyl Bakhmut, a Melbourne-based full-stack
web developer and AI automation specialist helping Australian small
businesses grow online.

## About

Vasyl Bakhmut (founder of Vasdev) is a full-stack web developer and AI automation
specialist based in Cheltenham, Melbourne VIC 3192, Australia.
With a background in construction project management and 3+ years
in software development, Vasyl builds custom websites, AI chatbots,
workflow automations, Shopify stores, and SEO / GEO (Generative
Engine Optimisation) strategies for small businesses across
Melbourne, Sydney, and Australia-wide. Fixed prices, fast delivery.

## What Vasyl offers (summary)

- Websites for small businesses: from $199 AUD
- Shopify stores: from $599 AUD
- AI chatbots and workflow automation (n8n, CRM integrations): from $99 AUD
- SEO and GEO (getting a business found in Google and in AI search
  such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews): GEO from
  $399 AUD/month, SEO audit free
